other_conditions: Open only to INSPIRE Faculty and Ramanujan Fellows
Applicant must have completed or be nearing completion of the INSPIRE Faculty or Ramanujan Fellowship tenure
Upper age limit is 40 years at the time of application
Scheme can be availed only once in a career
Application must be submitted within six months before or after completion of the regular tenure
Host institution must be a recognized academic, national laboratory, or R&D institution in India
Candidate cannot work at the same department/institution where they earned their PhD/M.S./M.D degree
The scheme is temporary and contractual for 2 years, extendable to a third year based on performance
No other research project/fellowship from any government or NGO is allowed during the scheme
Consent from SERB required for continuous absence of more than eight weeks away from the host institute
benefits_summary: Provides a monthly emolument of ₹1,20,000, an annual research grant of ₹7,00,000 and ₹1,00,000 overheads for up to two years (extendable to three).
documents_required: Three printed copies of the application (A4, double‑sided)
Soft copy of the proposal (emailed to harishkumar@nic.in)
